note: The sentence ledger of the investor journey (docs/wave8-contracts.md, section 9): the copy module, the FAQ module and the eight content files of /investors/, plus the two shared modules the criteria page renders. Each sentence maps to one claim (C-nn), one existing page, or one decision; a heading or control label that states no fact about WE is marked label (seven words at most). tests/unit/wp-64/ledger.test.ts enumerates the sentences from the modules and parsed content files, fails on one with no mapping and on a mapping with no sentence, and runs the claims denylist over all of them. The file has no fetches: it quotes no outside source and makes no regulatory statement. Sentences carried over from the wave 7 /investors/ page (the not-an-offer statement, the limits list, the diligence line) map to C-14, the claim that fixed those limits; the handoff lists them for counsel.

I can state the problem, and who has it, in two plain sentences that a stranger would understand.
